descripcion: Polysaccharide obtained by fermentation, widely used as a thickener and stabilizer in food and beverage formulations. It provides viscosity that remains stable across temperature and pH variations and helps keep solids in suspension. Dosage is defined for each application and in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder, particle size varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Plant-based hydrocolloid obtained from the guar seed, valued for its high hydration capacity and its ability to thicken cold systems. It is used to add body, bind water, and stabilize food systems, with good synergy with other gums. Usage level is adjusted to the application and in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder, particle size varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Water-soluble cellulose derivative used as a thickener, stabilizer, and moisture-retention agent in food formulations. It helps control ice crystal formation and stabilize proteins in acidic beverages. Available in different viscosity grades according to the application requirement.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granules depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Hydrocolloid extracted from citrus peels, a classic reference for gelling and building texture in confectionery and fruit preserves. Depending on the type, it gels in the presence of sugar and acid or with calcium, allowing it to be adapted to products with different solids content. It is used in accordance with applicable food additive regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder, usually standardized with sugars depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Hydrocolloid obtained from red seaweed, used to gel, thicken, and stabilize aqueous and dairy systems. Its different types deliver everything from firm gels to creamy textures, with a marked affinity for milk proteins. Type selection depends on the application and the customer's process.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder, color and particle size vary depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Animal-derived protein with thermoreversible gelling capacity, a classic in confectionery and desserts. It provides elasticity, gloss, and a melt-in-the-mouth texture that is difficult to replicate with other hydrocolloids. It is offered in different gel strength grades according to the formulation requirement.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granules depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Hydrocolloid obtained from marine algae that forms firm gels that remain stable at relatively high temperatures. It is a non-animal alternative to gelatin in confectionery and pastry, and it is also used as a culture medium in laboratories. Dosage is adjusted to the desired texture and in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder, strips, or flakes depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Benchmark acidulant in the food and beverage industry, obtained by fermentation. It provides acidity and citrus notes, regulates pH, and acts as a metal sequestrant that supports color and flavor stability. Its versatility makes it a warehouse staple for multiple industries.
formas_referenciales: Crystalline solid — crystals or powder depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Acidulant associated with the acid profile of apples, delivering a longer-lasting, rounder acidity than citric acid. It is used to intensify fruit flavors and in high-impact sour confectionery. It is often combined with other acidulants to modulate the product's sensory profile.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granules depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Fermentation-derived acidulant with a mild, lactic acid profile, used to regulate pH and impart notes typical of fermented products. It contributes to preservation by lowering the pH of the medium in sauces, pickles, and processed meat products. It is used in accordance with the regulations applicable to each category.
formas_referenciales: Liquid — aqueous solution, concentration according to the batch specification

descripcion: Preservative widely used in acidic-pH foods and beverages to protect formulations against yeasts and molds. Its good water solubility makes it easy to incorporate into syrups, sauces, and beverages. Dosage is defined by product category and in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granules depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Widely used preservative that protects foods and beverages against molds and yeasts, with a neutral sensory profile. It is one of the most requested preservatives due to its versatility in bakery, dairy, sauces, and beverages. It is dosed by product category and in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — granules or powder depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Classic preservative in the baking industry, used to extend the shelf life of bread and baked goods against mold spoilage. It does not significantly interfere with fermentation yeasts at typical usage levels. It is also used in animal feed in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granules depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Antioxidant in widespread use in foods and beverages to protect color and flavor against oxidation. In baking it acts as a flour treatment agent, promoting dough development. It is also incorporated into premixes and fortification in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Crystalline solid — crystals or powder depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Fat-soluble antioxidant obtained from vegetable oils, used to delay the oxidation of fats and oils in foods. It is the usual choice when protecting fat systems with an additive associated with cleaner labels. It is dosed into the fat phase according to the system to be protected.
formas_referenciales: Viscous liquid — color varies depending on the origin and batch

descripcion: High-intensity sweetener derived from sucrose, with a clean sweet profile and very good stability during processing and storage. It enables sugar reduction in beverages, dairy, and pastry while maintaining the product's sensory profile. Usage level is defined by category and in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: High-intensity sweeteners obtained from the leaf of Stevia rebaudiana, used to reduce sugars with a botanical origin. The different grades and glycoside compositions make it possible to adjust the sweetness profile and residual notes to each application. They are used in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder, glycoside composition varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Dual-function polyol: a bulk sweetener and humectant that helps retain moisture and maintain product texture over time. It is a classic in confectionery, baking, and toothpastes. The choice between the solid and syrup presentations depends on each customer's process.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder or granules depending on the manufacturer and batch
Liquid — aqueous solution according to the batch presentation

descripcion: Natural emulsifier derived from soybean oil, a benchmark in chocolate making for viscosity control and in baking for improved dough handling. It facilitates the integration of fat and aqueous phases and acts as a dispersing and release agent. Available in fluid and de-oiled grades depending on the application.
formas_referenciales: Viscous liquid — color varies depending on the origin and batch
Solid — powder or granules in de-oiled grades depending on the manufacturer and batch

nombre: Mono- and Diglycerides of Fatty Acids
descripcion: General-purpose emulsifiers in the food industry, used to stabilize emulsions, aerate batters, and delay bread staling. They interact with starches and fats, improving the texture and sensory shelf life of products. Dosage depends on the fat system of each formulation.
formas_referenciales: Solid — beads, flakes, or powder depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Hydrophilic nonionic emulsifier, used to stabilize oil-in-water emulsions and to solubilize flavors and essential oils in aqueous systems. In ice cream it contributes to aeration and a smooth texture. It is used in foods in accordance with applicable additive regulations.
formas_referenciales: Viscous liquid — amber shade varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Plant-based protein ingredient with high protein content, used to enrich formulations and provide functionality. It offers emulsifying capacity, water retention, and gel formation in meat systems and beverages. A standard base for sports nutrition products and plant-based analogues.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder, color and particle size vary depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Dairy ingredient obtained from cheese whey, valued for its protein profile and its functionality in beverages and baked goods. It provides solubility, foaming capacity, and pleasant dairy notes. The different grades available are selected according to the protein content required by the application.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Starch-derived carbohydrate used as a bulking agent, drying carrier, and encapsulating agent for flavors and colors. Its relatively low hygroscopicity and neutral taste make it ideal for powdered blends and instant beverages. It is offered in different dextrose equivalent ranges depending on the application.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Family of starches treated to withstand demanding process conditions such as heat, acidity, and freeze-thaw cycles. They provide viscosity, stability, and texture in sauces, soups, and ready-to-eat products. The type of modification is selected according to the process and the target shelf life.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder, particle size varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Simple sugar derived from starch, with moderate sweetness and high fermentability, used as a sweetener and as a substrate in fermentation processes. In meat products it supports curing processes, and in confectionery it provides a characteristic cooling effect. A widely used raw material in baking and beverages.
formas_referenciales: Crystalline solid — powder or crystals depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Versatile salt used in foods as a chemical leavening agent and acidity regulator. In combination with acidulants it releases gas that provides volume and a fluffy texture in baked goods. Its use extends to effervescent beverages, cleaning, and animal feed in accordance with applicable regulations.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder, particle size varies depending on the manufacturer and batch

descripcion: Natural color obtained from annatto (achiote) seeds, traditional in Latin American cuisine. It delivers shades ranging from yellow to orange in cheeses, snacks, fats, and meat products. Available in water-soluble or oil-soluble versions depending on the system to be colored.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder depending on the manufacturer and batch
Liquid — dispersion or solution according to the batch presentation

descripcion: Natural color derived from the turmeric rhizome, used to impart intense yellow shades in foods and beverages. It is a natural alternative to synthetic yellows in mustards, seasonings, bakery, and dairy. Shade stability depends on the system and the processing conditions.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder depending on the manufacturer and batch
Liquid — oil-based or aqueous dispersion according to the batch presentation

descripcion: Natural color derived from cochineal, prized for its red and pink shades with high stability to heat and light. It is a classic in yogurts, sausages and processed meats, confectionery, and beverages, as well as in color cosmetics. The final shade depends on pH and the application system.
formas_referenciales: Solid — powder depending on the manufacturer and batch
Liquid — solution or dispersion according to the batch presentation

descripcion: Aromatic flavoring with the characteristic vanilla profile, one of the most widely used flavors in the food industry. It provides sweet, rounded notes in bakery, chocolate making, ice cream, and beverages, and is also used as a base note in perfumery. Dosage is adjusted to the target sensory profile.
formas_referenciales: Crystalline solid — powder or crystals depending on the manufacturer and batch
